name: NCAA D-I Northeast Regional Cross Country Championships
where: Farmingdale, NY · host Hofstra · Bethpage State Park
headline: NCAA D-I Northeast Regional Cross Country Championships
summary: Men: No. 11 Harvard and No. 13 Syracuse. Women: No. 27 Providence and No. 30 Boston College. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21. · Women 6K 11:00 a.m. · Men 10K 12:00 p.m.
